heardByWhisper: You are just outside a pen for holding slaves.  The people here are worn and beaten, destined to a life of slavery.  Around the pen, there are many guards and sleazy merchants looking at the slaves.  You see a boy that has a heart-shaped birthmark on his left shoulder.  As you stare at the boy, a sleazy fat merchant approaches you and says,  That young boy will bring a good price at gentle keep. I think I shall buy him.
